data.title: Arknights: Endfield Discord Account Link Page Now Live!
data.brief: The official Arknights: Endfield Discord server has introduced a new feature — the account link page
data.data:
The official Arknights: Endfield Discord server has introduced a new feature — the account link page is now officially live!

Connect now to receive [Oroberyl×100] and an exclusive role in the official Discord server.

>>>Link Now<<<


[How to Connect]

Step 1: Go to the account connection page, log into your Gryphline Account, and link your Arknights: Endfield game character.

Step 2: Log into your Discord account.

Step 3: After completing the first two steps, the page will automatically detect your login status, click [Connect Now] to complete the process.

After successfully connecting your accounts, manually click [Claim Rewards] to receive your rewards. Rewards will be sent to your in-game mail of the connected account. The mail will be valid for 30 days, so please claim it in time. There may be some delay in delivery, so thank you for your patience.

Once the connection process is complete, please visit the Arknights: Endfield official discord server and select [Linked Roles] to receive the corresponding role. There might be some delay during the distribution process, we appreciate your patience during this time.


We're working on more features. Stay tuned for future updates!


If you have any suggestions or feedback, please contact us through the #server-feedback channel or Modmail on the official Arknights: Endfield Discord server.

*Only game accounts on the Asia Server and the Americas / Europe Server are eligible for connecting.


Connect your Arknights: Endfield account and Discord account now!
